name: Rust
about: What Rust is: colours, comments, what a .rs file is, and how to build and debug one

debuggers.name: lldb-dap
debuggers.see: You do not debug src/main.rs, you debug what Cargo built: `program` defaults to ${root}/target/debug/${crate}, where ${crate} is the name in Cargo.toml. A workspace with no [package] of its own, or a binary that is not the package name, needs saying: {"debuggers": {"gdb": {"launch": {"program": "…"}}}} in your settings for this plugin. Needs gdb 14 or newer, or lldb-dap.
